heroText: Discover cheerful games, colors, drawing and more. Explore together, at your own pace.
activitiesText: Choose an activity and let your imagination grow!
colorsDesc: Can you find the right color?
soonDesc: New games and surprises are on the way.
worldsText: From the deep sea to the stars: there's always something to discover.
safeText: Baby4All is free, with no ads in children's activities. We recommend playing together with an adult for the youngest children.
footerText: Every child deserves a world of play and imagination!
drawInstruction: Pick a color and draw with your finger or mouse.
colorsInstruction: Which color is being asked for?
parentIntro: Information about Baby4All and its activities.
parentBody: Baby4All is for playing and exploring together. Activities for children aged 0–1 are primarily for parents. Supervise young children while playing. There are no accounts or chat features.
parentPrivacy: Privacy: your language preference is stored only on this device. This starter version uses no analytics, advertising or external fonts.
parentNote: This page is informational. A real parental gate has not been implemented yet.
